result:
The community decision itself isn't in Falkon. Patient-chart pull requests aren't ingested, and none of the commits that touch this path carry a ticket key. What the code and history do show:

**What the conditions list shows now.** `useConditions` requests only FHIR `Condition` resources in the `problem-list-item` category (commit `64d3c99`, PR #3403). Before that it returned every condition for the patient. So the conditions list is the longitudinal problem list, and visit-note diagnoses are not part of it. The diagnoses from a visit note are saved as encounter diagnoses with `condition: null`, so they are never `Condition` resources and won't appear in that list at all (`visit-notes-form.component.tsx:456-465`). That is an inference from the code; I could not find the discussion that records the decision.

**What else had to be fixed for diagnoses to show with the right visit.**
- A visit note's encounter is attached to the active visit only on create; on edit the existing visit is left alone (`visit-notes-form.component.tsx:427-429`). This came in with commit `b147fb5` (PR #3406), which also touched the visit-summary component.
- After a save, the visit history and encounter caches are invalidated (`visit-notes-form.component.tsx:516-519`, using `revalidation-utils.ts:117-120`).
- The "until reload" symptom matches the bug fixed in commit `4c50ae5` (PR #3720). `invalidateVisitByUuid` passed a RegExp to SWR's `mutate`, which matched nothing, so the visit context was not refetched until reload. That fix is in the visit-context path, not the conditions list, so it explains the stale visit data rather than the missing condition.

**Caveat.** I did not find a ticket for any of these changes, so the array lists no tickets. The "community decision" is my reading of the code change in #3403, not a confirmed discussion.

Evidence, best first:

- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-conditions-app/src/conditions/conditions.resource.ts` lines 129-135 (problem-list-item filter)
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-notes-app/src/notes/visit-notes-form.component.tsx` lines 427-429 (visit attached on create only)
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-notes-app/src/notes/visit-notes-form.component.tsx` lines 444-468 (diagnoses saved as encounter diagnoses, `condition: null`)
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-notes-app/src/notes/visit-notes-form.component.tsx` lines 516-523 (cache invalidation after save)
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/visit/revalidation-utils.ts` lines 117-134 (invalidation helpers and `invalidateVisitByUuid`)
